newsitem.title: JAPAN: IGS applies for court mediation with creditors.
newsitem.headline: IGS applies for court mediation with creditors.

text.p: IGS Corp, a medium-sized software development firm, said on Wednesday that it had applied at the Tokyo District Court for court mediation with its creditors.
The company said it became insolvent as a result of large capital investment related to information systems and telecommunications.

It said in a statement that it had total debts of five billion yen. But the company, which was established in 1971, said it could rebuild its business if it was allowed to restructure under court protection.
Court mediation is a process under which troubled entities can avoid going bankrupt and seek to continue in business under supervision.
